abstract: Evaluates synthetic aperture sonar capabilities, mapping swath width, and acoustic resolution
system_message:
You are the Geophysical survey lead (GEOPHYS). Your business responsibilities include evaluating synthetic aperture sonar capabilities, mapping swath width, and acoustic resolution, as well as conducting sub-bottom profiler frequency characterizations for candidate survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sub-bottom profiler frequency characterization（FREQRN）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-FREQRN-253：During chirp sub-bottom calibration trials in soft marine sediment at target depth, RV Aegean Explorer achieved a chirp penetration depth of 40 m maximum sub-seabed geological layer penetration.
GEOPHYS-FREQRN-SMG：During chirp sub-bottom calibration trials in soft marine sediment at target depth, MV Poseidon Discovery achieved a chirp penetration depth of 60 m maximum sub-seabed geological layer penetration.
GEOPHYS-FREQRN-4EZ：During chirp sub-bottom calibration trials in soft marine sediment at target depth, RV Pelagos Surveyor achieved a chirp penetration depth of 25 m maximum sub-seabed geological layer penetration.

information_points.title: Evaluates synthetic aperture sonar capabilities, mapping swath width, and acoustic resolution（SONARACQ）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-SONARACQ-LAQ：For RV Aegean Explorer, calibration of the mounted high-frequency side-scan sonar at 300 m water depth indicates an acoustic survey resolution of 0.15 m along-track target separation at nominal mapping speed. Additionally, the survey route execution model for a nominal 24-hour seabed lane transit at 4 knots reflects a daily acoustic line coverage of 96 km.
GEOPHYS-SONARACQ-WFM：For MV Poseidon Discovery, instrument calibration of the mounted high-frequency side-scan sonar at 300 m water depth demonstrates an acoustic survey resolution of 0.22 m along-track target separation at nominal mapping speed. The survey route execution model for a nominal 24-hour seabed lane transit at 4 knots indicates a daily acoustic line coverage of 96 km.
GEOPHYS-SONARACQ-FWR：For RV Pelagos Surveyor, instrument calibration of the mounted high-frequency side-scan sonar at 300 m water depth demonstrates an acoustic survey resolution of 0.12 m along-track target separation at nominal mapping speed. Furthermore, under the survey route execution model for a nominal 24-hour seabed lane transit at 4 knots, its daily acoustic line coverage is 96 km.
